citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Storm Events Database, 2014-2026. U.S. government work, public domain. https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/stormevents/

events.title: Heavy Rain near Paradise
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Rain in the Las Vegas Valley led to flowing water in the Harmon Wash, leading to a swift water rescue of two women in the wash. One man in the wash is still missing and presumed dead.

events.title: Flash Flood near Henderson
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. There were multiple swift water rescues of people stuck in cars. One man was swept down a wash and drowned.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Callville Bay
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Clark County. One person died after being knocked off his paddleboard and into Lake Mead by outflow winds from thunderstorms in Arizona. Five other people were rescued.

events.title: Flash Flood near Las Vegas N Air Term
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Numerous streets and intersections were flooded, with water up to car windows in some cases. Several vehicles were stuck, including a city bus, and at least four water rescues were needed. One boy drowned.

events.title: Flash Flood near Las Vegas N Air Term
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Multiple rounds of rain produced flooding throughout the day. A sinkhole near Jones and Flamingo exposed a gas pipeline. Numerous streets were flooded and closed, and many cars were stuck in flood waters around the valley. Heavy rain caved in the roof of a small business and water poured in. One person was found dead in a detention basin.

events.title: Flash Flood near Bracken
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Flash flooding occurred on the Strip, which was described as a river, as well as nearby roads. Water came into at least two Strip casinos through light fixtures and/or failed ceilings. One person drowned after being swept down the Flamingo Wash, and another person was reported missing.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Las Vegas N Air Term
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Clark County. Rain throughout the Las Vegas Valley led to multiple crashes on the freeways. One man was killed when his vehicle overturned while traveling too fast for the wet conditions.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Cottonwood Lndg
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. A man was swimming near Cottonwood Cove when outflow winds from distant thunderstorms prevented him from making it back to his boat.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Bracken
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Heavy rain damaged classrooms, books, and electronics at Rose Warren Elementary School and poured through the roof of the Planet Hollywood casino. One man drowned in a wash near Giles St and Mandalay Bay Rd.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Vly Siding
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Clark County. Rain was a factor in a fatal car crash at 215 and Losee Rd.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Cottonwood Lndg
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Clark County. Thunderstorms produced strong winds near Cottonwood Cove. A man was killed when he became entangled in the mooring line of a house boat and dragged under the water.

events.title: Flash Flood near Bracken
events.description: 1 death. Clark County. Six people were rescued from the Flamingo Wash behind the Linq Hotel, and roads were closed in the area due to flooding. Two people were swept into the Flamingo Wash near Boulder Highway. One man, who had been rescuing people from the wash, was killed.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Ute
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Clark County. Heavy rain and hail contributed to a motorcycle crash on I-15 near mile marker 81. One man was killed.

events.title: Flash Flood near Red Rock Canyon
events.description: 2 deaths (1 direct, 1 indirect). Clark County. Several intersections were inundated with fast flowing water and debris, and eight swift water rescues occurred. Two people were killed (one direct and one indirect), and one person was injured.
